'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Young DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Young]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Joseph Young
* '''Deck name:''' Ralltiir
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
